success_criteria.name: Comfort Model Generalization vs Baseline
success_criteria.threshold: Best ML model beats best baseline by >= +0.05 macro-F1 on identical complete-case test rows (58,512 rows) under Leave-One-Köppen-Group-Out CV
success_criteria.explanation: Reported honestly as a negative result: the ML champion (Ablation A3 with outdoor temperature) achieved 0.4785 macro-F1, falling short of physical Adaptive 90% (0.4939). Dual comfort judges are therefore retained throughout coupling and optimization to avoid single-model bias.

success_criteria.name: XGBoost Surrogate Model Accuracy
success_criteria.threshold: Surrogates reach R2 >= 0.95 on held-out 20% test designs across all 25 models
success_criteria.explanation: 23 of 25 surrogate models exceeded R2 >= 0.95. Two targets marginally missed the strict threshold: Mumbai O1_ml (R2 = 0.9406) and Shimla warm_ml (R2 = 0.9225). Annual HVAC energy (O2) achieved high fidelity with mean R2 = 0.987 across all 5 climate zones.

success_criteria.name: Direct EnergyPlus Simulation Verification
success_criteria.threshold: At least 1 verified Pareto design per city beats BOTH R1 (Lightweight) and R2 (Conventional) reference shelters across all three objectives (O1_ml, O1_adapt, and O2)
success_criteria.explanation: Verified in all 5 climate zones by 100 direct EnergyPlus physical simulation runs. Pareto designs beat both reference shelters simultaneously in Jodhpur (7/10), Mumbai (7/10), New Delhi (6/10), Bengaluru (8/10), and Shimla (8/10).

success_criteria.name: Decision-Support Application Usability
success_criteria.threshold: Dashboard runs locally with one command, operates strictly read-only on saved artifacts, with zero external network or paid API dependencies, displaying applicability flags
success_criteria.explanation: Full application operates completely client-side and offline on precomputed simulation and surrogate artifacts. All test cases passed with zero exceptions.

assumptions.name: Continuous Occupancy
assumptions.value: 24 hours/day occupancy reflecting emergency/passive shelter use.

assumptions.name: Indoor Air Velocity
assumptions.value: Constant 0.15 m/s still indoor baseline air speed.

assumptions.name: Dynamic Clothing Model
assumptions.value: 0.5 clo if Daily Mean Ta >= 25°C; 0.7 clo if 15°C <= Ta < 25°C; 1.0 clo if Ta < 15°C.

assumptions.name: Ideal-Loads HVAC Setpoints
assumptions.value: Cooling setpoint 26°C, heating setpoint 20°C for objective O2.

assumptions.name: Reference R1 Lightweight
assumptions.value: No insulation (roof=0, wall=0), light mass, solar absorptance 0.85, WWR 0.15, shading 0.0 m, 5 ACH.

assumptions.name: Reference R2 Conventional
assumptions.value: No insulation (roof=0, wall=0), medium clay brick mass, solar absorptance 0.60, WWR 0.15, shading 0.0 m, 5 ACH.

decisions.title: Single-zone shelter baseline
decisions.description: Single-zone, low-rise shelter simulated in EnergyPlus across 5 Indian climate zones.

decisions.title: Representative Climate Stations
decisions.description: Jodhpur (hot-dry), Mumbai (warm-humid), New Delhi (composite), Bengaluru (temperate), Shimla (cold).

decisions.title: Missing-data-tolerant training, complete-case evaluation
decisions.description: Model learns from 18,061 Indian rows while preserving 100% identical-row complete-case evaluation.

decisions.title: Never impute tr = ta
decisions.description: Radiant temperature is the primary physics altered by envelope design; imputing removes optimization leverage.

decisions.title: Shimla applicability warning
decisions.description: Shimla has no labelled votes in DB II; cold winter hours carry explicit extrapolation flag.

decisions.title: Dual comfort judges
decisions.description: Retain both ML Champion and Physical Adaptive 90% as dual judges to prevent single-model bias.

decisions.title: Decision-support confidence tiers
decisions.description: Medium confidence requires Spearman rs >= 0.8 AND Adaptive 90% validity >= 80%; otherwise Low confidence.

design_variables.name: Wall Mass Class
design_variables.description: Thermal mass: Light (timber/sheet), Medium (clay brick), Heavy (concrete block).

design_variables.name: Roof Solar Absorptance
design_variables.description: Fraction of solar radiation absorbed by the roof (lower = cool white roof).

design_variables.name: Window-to-Wall Ratio
design_variables.description: Glazing area as percentage of external wall area.

design_variables.name: Orientation
design_variables.description: Azimuth angle (0° = North, 90° = East, 180° = South, 270° = West).

design_variables.name: Natural Ventilation
design_variables.description: Air changes per hour provided by passive cross-ventilation.
